QF.id: XC Investment Products and Market Developments_12

question.text: In a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP), the investor:

answer.text: Makes regular investments at fixed intervals into a mutual fund
Makes recurring redemptions from the mutual fund scheme to receive a regular, defined payout
Transfers units from one mutual fund scheme to another at regular intervals
Receives guaranteed dividend payments at regular intervals

explanation.text: The Logic: A Systematic Withdrawal Plan enables recurring redemptions from a mutual fund scheme. The investor selects the frequency, date, and tenor of withdrawals, and units are redeemed at the applicable NAV to produce a defined payout. The Trap: Regular investments at fixed intervals describe a SIP; transfers between schemes describe an STP; and mutual fund dividends are not guaranteed payments. Note: Applicable exit loads and capital-gains tax implications may apply on each SWP redemption, so the net payout can differ from the gross withdrawal amount.
